description:
WS8 of _project/planning/ci-failure-reduction-plan.md. Two triage-loop hardening items:

(1) A 2026-07-23 API snapshot showed auto_merge: null on open PRs whose auto-merge-on-open `enable` job had succeeded. May be timing, may be silent failure (e.g. token permissions after ruleset changes) - prior art: harden-auto-merge-on-open-stranding (done) diagnosed exactly this class when 3 remediation fixes were orphaned. Rather than modifying the owner-gated auto-merge-on-open.yml, add a nightly sweep: open non-draft PR + green required lane + auto-merge off + not soundness-gated = alert. This catches stranding regardless of cause.

(2) The triage judgment rules currently live only in a hand-carried prompt (stale-SHA verification before acting on webhook events; the GitHub-outage signature - whole run failing at setup steps with Unicorn HTML; worktree-based cross-branch comparison, never `git checkout <ref> --`; conflict-resolution rules for TODO modify/delete). Codify them in docs/operations/pr-triage.md so any session/agent inherits them without prompt archaeology.

anti_patterns.dont: Have the sweep enable auto-merge itself on hits
anti_patterns.instead: Alert only; a human or the triage loop re-runs the sanctioned enable path
anti_patterns.why: That re-implements the owner-gated enable path outside its soundness predicate

anti_patterns.dont: Paste the triage prompt verbatim into docs
anti_patterns.instead: Extract only the durable judgment rules; keep live state in the tracker
anti_patterns.why: It mixes session-specific state (PR numbers, dates) with durable rules

preserves.behavior: Soundness-gated PRs are excluded from the sweep's alert (their auto-merge-off state is correct by design)
auto-merge-on-open.yml is owner-gated and untouched - the sweep is external observation

verifications.description: Sweep dry-run classifies current open PRs correctly
verifications.expected: soundness PRs excluded; stranded PRs (if any) listed

work_units.summary: Nightly green-but-unmerged sweep for non-soundness PRs with auto-merge off; alert on hits
Investigate the auto_merge:null observation; document root cause (timing vs real stranding) in the item evidence
Write docs/operations/pr-triage.md codifying the judgment rules from the triage prompt; link from AGENTS.md Further Reading
